name: NGC 6822 SC1 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6822 SC1, a globular cluster of the dwarf irregular galaxy NGC 6822, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6822sc1-hubble
story: SC1 is the most remote known globular cluster of NGC 6822, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy. It is one of three far-flung clusters there whose stars are very poor in heavy elements, a trait astronomers link to clusters in the outer halo of M31.

claims.text: NGC6822-SC1 is a globular cluster target of Hubble program 15336
NGC 6822 is an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy
NGC 6822 is a Local Group dwarf irregular galaxy
SC1 is the most remote globular cluster of NGC 6822
SC1 is one of the three outermost NGC 6822 clusters, which are very metal-poor
These outlying clusters resemble clusters associated with substructure in M31's outer halo
